text: Normal designated-entry return or authorized lifecycle-agent `exit value` shall request orderly shutdown. `exit` shall require i32, terminate its block with no successors, and report that exact logical status; it shall not be a function return or catchable exception. Normal entry-result status mapping shall be defined by the environment.
